summary: Landwirtschaftliche Rentenbank, a German federal-agency issuer, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a benchmark offering of senior unsecured notes denominated in U.S. dollars, listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and guaranteed by the Federal Republic of Germany. Price, coupon, maturity and size are left blank in this preliminary filing, with underwriters Banco Santander, J.P. Morgan, Nomura and Societe Generale. Delivery is book-entry via DTC, Euroclear and Clearstream. The notes are non-callable except for tax-redemption. Routine debt capital-markets issuance, not a special situation; no deal terms stated. Watch final pricing and spread to Bunds.
